description: Weighted readiness estimate for a transparent, source-gated HK law assistant. Percentages are engineering/product-readiness estimates, not legal validation.
overall_warning: This is a public-source demo readiness model. It must not be read as lawyer approval, corpus completeness, or private/licensed-source readiness.

evidence: source registry, public corpus manifest, storage schema, Qdrant index scripts, answer contracts, and source-gated answer schema exist
DigitalOcean/FastAPI/Qdrant demo scaffold exists with private ingestion disabled by default
sections.remaining: Convert local/demo scaffolds into production services with durable orchestration, deployment secrets, and operational monitoring.

evidence: public corpus v1 registry defines 30+ public/demo-safe source candidates
the small inconsistent-pleadings pilot has embedded chunk/proposition coverage
bail_public_batch_v1 adds two real public Judiciary case sources with quote-verified candidate paragraph/proposition cards
sections.remaining: Ingest a large public HK cases/legislation corpus with paragraph/provision cards, citation normalization, deduplication, and no private source leakage.

evidence: local Qdrant collections and deterministic dev embeddings prove the indexing/search path
retrieval benchmark suite exists and honestly reports insufficient quality until more corpus and real retrieval are configured
sections.remaining: Replace local-hash vectors with real embeddings, add production reranking, run quality gates against golden HK criminal procedure/evidence queries, and scale only after source-hit quality passes.

evidence: source-gated claims include review_state, answer_safe, and human_review_required
main answer path separates research-only machine candidates from answer-safe reviewed propositions
sections.remaining: Run answer cross-checking across broader domains and prevent unsupported propositions from appearing as final law in all composers.

evidence: machine_candidate -> quote_verified -> source_verified -> lawyer_reviewed -> answer_safe promotion rules exist
local review workflow validation records promotion audit history
sections.remaining: Connect review workflow to real admin UI/API, Supabase-backed queues, reviewer identity, audit logs, and rejection/rollback paths.

evidence: DigitalOcean demo scaffold, Clerk configuration docs, tenant-filter validators, and private-ingestion-disabled defaults exist
sections.remaining: Deploy with real managed secrets, Clerk JWT verification, tenant namespaces, access logs, and private-source authorization before any private book/form ingestion.

evidence: retrieval_bundles, legal_answer_snapshots, and sop_playbooks schema is present
API cache helpers exist
sections.remaining: Add stale-source invalidation tests and broader SOP/playbook reuse policies.

evidence: v0.6 case-to-proposition graph builder converts demo case fixtures into paragraph cards, proposition cards, tree attachments, review queue items, and source-gated evidence packs
v0.7 public bail batch fetches public Judiciary judgment text and creates quote-verified candidate proposition cards
sections.remaining: Expand public-source batches section by section and connect generated cards to Supabase review queues and production retrieval.

evidence: criminal/evidence doctrine and procedure trees cover pleadings, proof, admissibility, confession, voir dire, identification, hearsay, similar fact, silence, abuse, delay, bail, appeal, and discretion
sections.remaining: Deepen nodes with real source-card anchors, exceptions, procedural consequences, and neighbouring-node edges.

evidence: candidate proposition extraction exists in deterministic CASE_GRAPH_LLM_PROVIDER=none mode
public bail batch requires exact quotes to be present in fetched public paragraph text before creating propositions
sections.remaining: Generalize quote-exact public-case extraction beyond bail and add party-submission/procedural-history classifiers at scale.

evidence: propositions attach to doctrine/procedure nodes by fixture metadata and taxonomy keywords
public bail batch attaches quote-verified propositions to stable criminal_procedure_hk doctrine_node_id values by audited extraction rules
sections.remaining: Add citation-aware, significance-aware attachment review for real public case paragraphs.

evidence: review queue groups proposition cards by tree node, significance label, confidence, case, and missing metadata
sections.remaining: Connect queue to Supabase/admin UI and reviewer audit identity.

evidence: 20-query case graph benchmark validates confession, identification, hearsay, similar fact, proof, abuse, delay, bail, appeal, silence, and procedural fairness routing
sections.remaining: Replace fixture benchmark with public-case benchmark and expected authority hits.

evidence: bail-only L4/L5 pilot links a demo case proposition to existing criminal_procedure_hk doctrine_node_id values as candidate-only evidence
bail_public_batch_v1 adds 8 real public-source candidate propositions, 16 doctrine links, and L5 exact-quote proof cards from Lai Chee Ying and Tong Ying Kit
sections.remaining: Promote reviewed bail cards through Supabase review workflow, add more public bail cases, then expand section by section.
